Lucky! You found the solution on your first guess!
at the start of every game a solution consisting of four pegs is randomly generated
a solution can have more than one peg of the same colour
you have ten chances to figure out the colours of the solution in the correct order
place your pegs by using the buttons at the bottom of the screen
you can undo choices of the current guess before the fourth peg has been placed
once a guess is complete, up to four clues will appear to the right of the guess
a yellow clue means that one of your pegs is of the correct colour but in the wrong position
a green clue means that one of your pegs is of the correct colour and is in the correct position
remember that the position of a clue has no relevance to the position of the corresponding peg
the game ends when you have guessed the sequence correctly, or you run out of guesses
